arStrings.szText: Didn’t I? The Seer wasn't wrong. I questioned Akarat behind closed doors. But I did nothing until you dragged me from Adreona’s shadow.
Soft and reflective. Bitter towards herself - she much to make up for
Amazons are bred for obedience. To hear a command and strike without hesitation. That creed makes us strong in battle. Now it has outdone us.
The Seer calls for eyes. Blood answers blood.
